column5: The bounded Rust node owns one fail-closed startup cap for its first fixed-width signed-BIGINT ORDER BY LIMIT heap: default 1024 rows, explicit 65536-row ceiling, positive decimal parsing, duplicate rejection, and documented help. TiDB TOML/global/dynamic configuration, memory quotas, spilling, resource groups, and general statement semantics remain open.

The real-TiKV-only bounded startup store contract is retained while the one NodeConfig gains the TopN cap; TiDB's full store registry, security configuration, dynamic reload, and general configuration surface remain open.
